sources: Enemy pages: Reaper_Trainee, Tetrabrachia, Archon_Rame, Kamaitachi, Gallotrice, Swordian (Statbox Enemy, retrieved 2026-09-29)
Enemies already in other data/enemies files (IMP, SKULLINO, SKULL2_EASY, GHOST, HARPY, MEDUSA2_AGGRO, KALI1, SKELEWING, SKELEWING_INO, XLBAT, BAT3, BOSS_XLDEATH) are not repeated here.

field_notes.hp: max health at spawn before stage multiplier (Mad Forest enemy_health = 1.0)
field_notes.speed: wiki MoveSpeed units (player base speed unit is not stated on these pages; treat as relative)
field_notes.knockback: multiplier on weapon knockback (0 = wiki lists 0, i.e. described as semi/fully resistant depending on page text; negative = pulled toward player)
field_notes.hp_x_level: true means health is multiplied by the player's level at spawn time

BRIDGE_TRAINEE.name: Reaper Trainee (bridge)
BRIDGE_TRAINEE.special: chases player; the Reaper Trainee page also lists a yellow variant TRAINEE_Y with the same stats

BRIDGE_TETRA.name: Tetrabrachia (bridge)
BRIDGE_TETRA.special: regular enemy; same stats as Tetrabrachia 2 (KALI2)

BRIDGE_ARMOR.name: Archon Rame (bridge)
BRIDGE_ARMOR.special: regular enemy; wave table calls it Archon Rame/Oro (bridge)

BRIDGE_MINION.name: Bridge Minion (Kamaitachi variant)
BRIDGE_MINION.special: reduced knockback; wave table calls it Kamaitachi/Bridge Minion

XLSWORDIAN_V.name: Swordian V
XLSWORDIAN_V.special: Monster Rain enemy; fixed direction, floaty

BOSS_XLSWORDIAN_2.name: Arcana Swordian
BOSS_XLSWORDIAN_2.special: boss; HP x player level; Arcana holder, only spawns if Arcanas are enabled

unknowns: Wave 10 'Tetrabrachia' mapped to KALI1 (the Tetrabrachia page lists Tiny Bridge 10:00 under Tetrabrachia 1).
Wave 0-2 'Reaper Trainee (bridge)' uses BRIDGE_TRAINEE (5 HP, speed 140).
